sources.title: GitHub - antoniodeepblue/huggingface.co-openai-clip-vit-base-patch32
sources.snippet: The model uses a ViT-B/32 Transformer architecture as an image encoder and uses a masked self-attention Transformer as a text encoder. These encoders are trained to maximize the similarity of (image, text) pairs via a contrastive loss.
